blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI-text detectors reach near-perfect scores in evaluations that contrast fully human-written texts with texts generated from researcher-designed prompts. In authentic student writing, however, AI use is voluntary and often partial. We study this setting with the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which 15-year-olds in Germany wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a gpt-4o-mini-based chatbot. Keystroke, clipboard and chat logs let us trace every character of the final essay to its origin. From this provenance, we derive text- and sentence-level labels for human-written, AI-generated and mixed text, and for text written after chatbot use without traceable AI material. We evaluate a feature-based detector and a classifier on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings, both adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems. Both separate AI from human text reliably (macro-F1 up to 0.96 for texts and 0.95 for sentences), independently of spelling errors. The feature-based detector, however, relies on lexical complexity, which a simple student-style rewriting prompt removes (AI recall 0.92 $\to$ 0.60 with gpt-4o-mini, 0.41 with Qwen3). The embedding-based detector stays robust for whole texts (AI recall $\geq$ 0.94) but not for single sentences (AI recall as low as 0.59). Mixed text falls between the two classes, and text without traceable AI material is classified as human-written in about 95\% of texts.
blocks.zh: AI-文本探测器在评价中达到近乎完美的分数,这些分数将完全人文文字与研究人员设计的提示所生成的文字相比较。 然而,在真正的学生写作中,AI的使用是自愿的,而且常常是部分的. 我们用PISA 2025 FLA数据集来研究这个设置,其中德国15岁的孩子写了英语的辩证散文,有和没有访问gpt-4o-mini-based talkbot. Keystroke,剪贴板和聊天日志让我们追踪最后散文的每个字符的出处. 从这个出处,我们从文字和句子层次的标签中得出了人类写作的,AI生成和混合的文字,以及聊天组使用后所写而无可追踪的AI材料的文字. 我们评价一个基于地物的探测器和一个冷冻的Llama-3.1-8B嵌入物的分级器,两者都是从排名最高的共享任务系统改编而来. 两者都将AI与人文文本可靠地分开(文本为macro-F1至0.96,句子为0.95),独立于拼写错误. 然而以地物为主的探测器依赖于词典上的复杂性,简单的学生风格重写会被迅速删除(AI回想0.92美元到0.60美元为克特-4o-mini,0.41为克特-克特-克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克特克 嵌入式探测器在整个文本(AI召回0.94美元)中保持坚固,但单句(AI召回,低至0.59美元)则没有. 混合文本在两个类别之间倒下,没有可追踪的AI材料的文本在约95\%的文本中被归类为人文.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Generative AI has become part of how students write: surveys report widespread use of chatbots for homework and writing assignments. In Germany, 57% of 12- to 19-year-olds had used ChatGPT by 2024, and two thirds of those using AI tools do so for school and homework ( Feierabend et al., 2024 ) ; surveys in the US show a similar trend ( Sidoti et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 基因AI成为学生写作方式的一部分:调查报告称广泛使用聊天器做功课和写作任务. 在德国,截至2024年,12至19岁的人中有57%使用过ChatGPT, 使用AI工具的人中有三分之二使用过ChatGPT(Feirerabend等人,2024年);美国的调查也显示出类似的趋势(Sidoti等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: For writing assessment, this raises a validity problem: if a text may have been produced partly by a chatbot, it no longer shows reliably what the student can do, and teachers find it hard to tell students’ own writing from generated text ( Cotton et al., 2024 ; Fleckenstein et al., 2024 ) . Automated detectors are therefore increasingly used in education ( Turnitin, 2023 ) , although their errors are costly: a false positive amounts to an accusation of misconduct, and widely used detectors misclassify texts by non-native writers as AI-generated at high rates ( Liang et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于写作评估来说,这引起了一个有效性问题:如果一个文本可能是部分由聊天员制作的,那么它就不再可靠地显示学生能做什么,而教师们觉得很难从生成的文本中告诉学生自己的写作(Cotton等人,2024年;Fleckenstein等人,2024年). 因此,自动探测器越来越多地用于教育(Turnitin, 2023年),尽管其错误代价很高:假阳性等于对不当行为的指控,而且广泛使用的探测器将非本土作者的文本错误分类为高费率的AI生成(Liang等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
In published evaluations, such detectors perform very well: in the 2025 AI vs. Human shared task on academic essays, the best systems reached macro-F1 above 0.98 ( Chowdhury et al., 2025 ) . These evaluations, however, compare fully human-written texts with texts that researchers generated from carefully designed prompts.
Students’ AI use in the classroom might look different, as they decide themselves whether to use a chatbot, prompt it loosely, combine its output with their own writing, or use it only for ideas. Partial use also means that AI material may be confined to individual sentences, so a useful detector should not only decide whether a text contains AI material but also where . It is unclear how detectors behave on such texts, how they treat partial AI use, and whether students could evade them with simple means.
blocks.zh:
在公布的评价中,这种探测器的性能非常好:在2025年AI诉人类学术论文分担的任务中,最佳系统达到0.98以上的宏观F1(Cowdhury等人,2025年)。 然而,这些评价将人文文本与研究人员精心设计的提示所产生的文本作充分比较。
学生的AI在课堂上的用法可能有所不同,因为他们自己决定是使用聊天机,松散地激发它,将其输出与自己的写作相结合,还是只用它来表达想法。 部分使用还意味着AI材料可能局限于个别句子,因此一个有用的探测器不仅应该决定一个文本是否包含AI材料,而且还应该决定其中的. 目前还不清楚探测器对这类文本的表现如何,它们如何对待部分AI的使用,以及学生是否可以以简单的方式逃避.

blocks.en: We study these questions on the PISA 2025 FLA dataset, in which students in Germany aged 15 wrote English argumentative essays with and without access to a chatbot based on gpt-4o-mini . Keystrokes, clipboard operations and chat interactions were logged, so we can trace every character of the final essay to its origin: typed by the student, pasted from the chatbot, or retyped from it. From this provenance, we derive labels at text and sentence level that distinguish human-written ( human ), AI-generated ( ai ) and mixed text, as well as text written after chatbot use that contains no traceable AI material ( potential_influence , pi ). Unlike labels derived from the experimental condition, e.g. if students had access to a chatbot or not, these reflect what actually ended up in the essay.
blocks.zh: 我们在PISA 2025 FLA数据集上研究这些问题, 其中德国15岁学生写了英文辩证散文, 键盘键盘、剪贴板操作和聊天互动被记录下来,这样我们就可以将最后散文的每个字符追踪到其来源:由学生键入,从聊天机粘贴,或从中重排. 从这个出处,我们从文字和句子层面推导出区分人文(人文),AI生成(ai)和混合文本的标签,以及聊天机器人使用后写出的没有可追踪的AI材料(潜在_影响,pi)的文本. 与实验条件衍生的标签不同,例如,如果学生能够访问聊天机或不访问,这些标签反映了散文中实际的结局.

blocks.en: On this data, we evaluate two complementary detectors adapted from top-ranked shared-task systems: a feature-based classifier over interpretable linguistic features ( Indurthi and Varma, 2025 ) and a classifier over frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings ( Jiao et al., 2025 ) . We ask:
blocks.zh: 在这个数据上,我们评价两个从排名最高的共享任务系统改编的互补探测器:一个基于特征的分类器比可解释的语言特征(Indurthi and Varma, 2025),另一个是冷冻Llama-3.1-8B嵌入物的分类器(Jiao等人,2025年)。 我们问:

blocks.en: RQ1 How well do state-of-the-art detectors identify AI-authored text in ecologically valid student writing, at text and sentence level? How do they treat text that combines AI output with the student’s own writing, and text written after chatbot use that contains no copied or retyped AI output? RQ2 What do the detectors rely on, and is it robust to changes a student could plausibly make, such as fixing or adding spelling errors, or asking the chatbot to make its text sound like a student’s?
blocks.zh: 问题1 最先进的探测器在文字和句子层面如何识别生态有效的学生写作中的AI作者文本? 他们如何对待将AI输出和学生自己写作相结合的文本,以及使用聊天机器人后编写的包含没有复制或重排的AI输出的文本? 问题2 检测器所依赖的是什么, 以及它是否强健地改变一个学生可以令人信服的, 例如修补或添加拼写错误, 或是要求聊天机让自己的文字听起来像学生的文字?

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Research on AI-generated text in education has asked two questions: how well humans, in particular teachers, can tell AI-generated from student writing, and how well automated detectors can.
blocks.zh: 对教育领域AI生成的文本的研究提出了两个问题:人类,尤其是教师,能在多大程度上告诉AI从学生写作中生成,以及自动化探测器能有多好.

blocks.en:
Teachers distinguish AI-generated from student writing only moderately well. Pre-service and experienced teachers recognised fewer than half of GPT-4-generated essays (recall = 45.1% and 37.8%), and their confidence was unrelated to their accuracy ( Fleckenstein et al., 2024 ) . College instructors picked ChatGPT essays from a pair in 70% of cases (chance: 50%; Waltzer et al., 2024 ). Both instructors and novice EFL teachers report relying mainly on the absence of errors ( Waltzer et al., 2024 ; De Wilde, 2024 ) , so that well-written learner texts are sometimes taken for AI. Experiment 3 tests whether automated detectors share this reliance.
Humans thus detect AI-generated text only moderately above chance, if at all, and their general confidence says little about their accuracy, which motivates automated detection.
blocks.zh:
教师对人工智能和学生写作的区别不大。 任职前和有经验的教师承认的GPT-4产生的论文不到一半(回顾=45.1%和37.8%),他们的信心与其准确性无关(Fleckenstein等人,2024年)。 学院教员在70%的案例中从一对中挑选了ChatGPT散文(chance:50%;Waltzer等人,2024年)。 教员和新EFL教师都报告主要依靠没有错误(Waltzer等人,2024年;De Wilde,2024年),因此有时会为AI采集写得很好的学习者文本. 实验3测试自动化探测器是否分享这种依赖.
因此,人类检测AI生成的文本,即使只是略高于概率,他们一般的信心也很少说出其准确性,这促使自动检测。

blocks.en: On Graduate Record Examination essays, Jiang et al. (2024) detected gpt-3.5-turbo essays with accuracy above 0.98 and suggested keystroke logs for the harder case of partial AI use, which our dataset captures. The 2025 AI vs. Human shared task ( Chowdhury et al., 2025 ) contrasted IELTS and TOEFL essays with essays generated by seven LLMs, among them gpt-4o-mini , prompted to write like non-native students; the top systems reached macro-F1 above 0.98. We adopt two complementary systems from it. Jiao et al. (2025) (rank 1 for English, macro-F1 = 0.999) classify mean-pooled hidden states of a frozen Llama-3.1-8B with a small convolutional network; their ablations attribute most of the signal to the LLM representation. Indurthi and Varma (2025) (rank 6, macro-F1 = 0.986) train classical classifiers on interpretable style, complexity, bias, affect and moral features, of which complexity features were the most discriminative.
blocks.zh: 在研究生记录考试散文中,Jiang等人(2024年)检测到精度超过0.98的gpt-3.5-turbo散文,并推荐了键盘记录,用于部分AI使用的较难案例,我们数据集对此进行了捕捉. 2025年AI对人类分担的任务(乔杜里等人,2025年)将IELTS和TOEFL散文与7个LLM(包括gpt-4o-mini)产生的散文对比,促使他们像非本土学生一样写作;顶级系统达到0.98以上的宏F1. 我们从中采用了两个相辅相成的制度。 Jiao等人(2025年)(英语排名1,macro-F1 = 0.999)将冰冻的Llama-3.1-8B的中池隐藏状态与小的革命网络进行分类;他们的浮雕将大部分信号归属于LLM代表. Indurthi and Varma (2025) (排名6, macro-F1=0.986) 训练古典分类师学习可解释的风格,复杂性,偏见,影响和道德特征,其中复杂性特征最为具有歧视性.

blocks.en:
Such results could suggest that the task is solved, but detectors are vulnerable to changes in surface form.
None of 14 tools tested by Weber-Wulff et al. (2023) exceeded an accuracy of 80%, and accuracy dropped to 42% for manually edited and 26% for paraphrased ChatGPT output. On student essays, simple perturbations, like synonym replacement, lowered the accuracy of fine-tuned RoBERTa detectors to 0.50–0.60 ( Peng et al., 2023 ) . Experiments 3 and 4 test related manipulations that a student could plausibly apply.
blocks.zh:
这种结果可能表明任务已经解决,但探测器容易受到表面形态变化的影响。
Weber-Wulff等人(2023年)测试的14个工具都没有超过80%的精度,手动编辑的精度降至42%,被解释的ChatGPT输出的精度降至26%. 关于学生的散文,简单的扰动,如同义词替换,将微调的RoBERTa探测器的精度降低到0.50–0.60(Peng等人,2023年). 实验3和4测试了学生可以合理应用的相关操纵.

blocks.en: In all these studies, the AI texts were prompted by researchers, and texts were either fully human-written or fully AI-generated; Weber-Wulff et al. (2023) explicitly left hybrid writing open. In our data, students used the chatbot voluntarily and combined its output with their own writing. Keystroke logs make every character attributable to its origin and allow labels for whole texts and single sentences, including partial ( mixed ) and untraceable ( pi ) AI use.
blocks.zh: 在所有这些研究中,AI文本都是由研究者推动的,文本要么完全由人书写,要么完全由AI生成;Weber-Wulff等人(2023年)明确保留混合写法. 在我们的数据中,学生们自愿使用聊天机,并将其输出与自己的写作相结合. Keystroke logs 将每个字符都归结于其起源,并允许对全文和单句进行标签,包括部分(混合)和无法追踪(pi)AI使用.

blocks.en: 3 Data
blocks.zh: 3 数据

blocks.en: We use data from a writing study conducted with 2,429 15-year-old students in German secondary schools alongside the PISA 2025 assessment, as an addition to the PISA 2025 Foreign Language Assessment ( OECD, 2021 ) . Following Schaller et al. (2026) , we refer to it as PISA 2025 FLA. The data comprise 4,091 writing sessions on two argumentative tasks ( advertisement and teacher ), taken from the MEWS study ( Keller et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们利用德国中学2 429名15岁学生的写作研究数据, 在Schaller等人(2026年)之后,我们将其称为PISA 2025 FLA。 数据包括4 091次关于两项辩证任务的写作(广告和教师),取自MEWS研究(Keller等人,2020年)。

blocks.en:
Each student wrote one essay per task — one with ( Chat ) and one without ( NoChat ) unrestricted access to a gpt-4o-mini -based chatbot for writing support ( OpenAI, 2024 ) . The assignment of conditions to tasks and the order in which the tasks were completed were randomized. Not all students completed both tasks.
Writing sessions were limited to 30 minutes and logged as an event stream of keystrokes, cursor positions, clipboard operations, and the full text of all chat requests and responses.
blocks.zh:
每个学生每个任务写一篇散文——一篇带有(聊天),一篇没有(NoChat)的无限制访问gpt-4o-mini-基于写作支持的聊天台(OpenAI,2024). 任务的条件分配和任务的完成顺序是随机的。 并非所有学生都完成了这两项任务。
编写会话限时30分钟,并记录为按键串流、光标位置、剪贴板操作以及所有聊天请求和回复的全文。

blocks.en:
In a naive approach, one might assign all essays from the Chat condition and all their contained sentences an AI gold standard label and label all NoChat material as human .
However, as users from the Chat group could have chosen not to use the chatbot and not every instance of chatbot use is reflected in the final essay, we assign the final labels in a more informed way by first determining every character’s origin and then aggregating this information into sentence and text labels. 1,889 of the 1,981 Chat essays involved chatbot use, but only 1,134 contain AI material in the final essay (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh:
以天真的方式,人们可能会将所有来自Chat条件的散文和所有包含的句子指定为AI金本位标签,并将所有NoChat材料标注为人类.
然而,由于来自Chat组的用户本可以选择不使用聊天器,而并非每个聊天器的使用实例都反映在最后的散文中,所以我们首先通过确定每个字符的起源,然后将这些信息汇总到句子和文字标签中,以更知情的方式来分配最终标签. 1,981篇查特散文中有1,889篇涉及聊天机器人的使用,但最终散文中只有1,134篇包含AI材料(附录D.

blocks.en: 3.1 Determining character provenance
blocks.zh: 3.1 确定特征来源

blocks.en: Characters entered by keystroke are labelled as typed . Pasted material inherits the origin of the most recent copy or cut event: chat for chatbot responses, task for the task description, and typed for text from the essay itself or the student’s own chat prompts.
blocks.zh: 按键键输入的字符标注为 。 粘贴的材料继承了最近复制或剪切事件的源头:聊天器响应,任务描述任务,以及从散文本身或学生自己的聊天提示中输入文本.

blocks.en: Since the logger occasionally misses copy events, a paste that does not match the clipboard content is compared to all chatbot responses received so far and labelled chat if its similarity is at least 0.85; otherwise it is marked as external . We measure similarity with difflib.SequenceMatcher ( Python Software Foundation, 2026 ) after lowercasing and normalising whitespace; if one text is fully contained in the other, similarity is set to 1.
blocks.zh: 由于日志员偶尔会错过复制事件,一个不匹配剪贴板内容的粘贴被比作迄今为止收到的所有聊天员回复和标签聊天,如果其相似性至少为0.85;否则它会被标记为外部的. 我们测量与difflib的相似性。 序列Matcher(Python Software Foundation,2026)在下架和正常白空间后;如果一个文本完全包含在另一个文本中,相似性被设定为1.

blocks.en:
We record two additional kinds of information necessary for the later gold standard label.
First, we record whether each character was inserted before or after the student’s first chatbot interaction, which separates human from potential_influence text (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们记录了以后金本位标签所需的另外两种信息。
首先,我们记录每个字符是在学生的第一次聊天员互动之前还是之后插入的,这种互动将人与潜在影响文本区分开来(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Second, as individual events are occasionally dropped by the logger, we use a rule-based heuristic to reconstruct the missing edit from the surrounding text states for such cases; characters originating from these reconstructions are marked as inferred , everything else as observed .
blocks.zh: 第二,由于个别事件偶尔被伐木者丢弃,我们使用基于规则的heuristic来重建周围文本状态中缺少的这类案件的编辑;这些重建产生的字符被标记为推断,其他一切都被观察.

blocks.en: 3.2 Gold Labels
blocks.zh: 3.2 黄金标签

blocks.en: We segment the final essays and the chatbot responses with pySBD ( Sadvilkar and Neumann, 2020 ) , adding a split rule for the frequent omission of whitespace after sentence-final punctuation in learner texts. Each sentence is then labelled based on the character provenance described in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们用pySBD(Sadvilkar和Neumann, 2020年)来分解最后的散文和聊天人的回应, 然后,每个句子都根据第3.1节所述特征的出处贴上标签。

blocks.en:
All sentences written before the first chatbot interaction, and all NoChat sentences, are labelled human , unless at least 10% of their characters come from unresolved pastes ( unknown_paste ) or at least 50% originate from the task description ( task ).
Thresholds were set manually. Varying them (AI share 80–95%, unresolved-paste share 5–20%, task share 30–70%, similarity 0.80–0.95) changes the labels of at most 1% of sentences, though it affects the size of the small mixed class.
blocks.zh:
在第一次聊天机器人交互之前写的所有句子,以及所有的NoChat句子,都被标注为人类 ,除非其至少10%的字符来自未解的粘贴(未知_paste)或至少50%来自任务描述(任务).
门槛是人工设定的。 不同(AI 共享 80–95 %,未解决的粘贴 共享 5–20 %,任务共享 30–70 %,相似性 0.80–0.95) 最多改变1%句子的标签,尽管它影响了小混合类的大小.

blocks.en: Post-AI sentences are labelled ai if at least 90% of their characters are AI-sourced, mixed if this share is above 0%, and potential_influence otherwise (see retyping below).
blocks.zh: AI后句子如果其至少90%的字符是AI源代码,如果该份额高于0%则混合,以及潜在影响(见下文重制版),则标注为ai。

blocks.en:
Manual retyping of chatbot output is not visible at character level, as retyped characters are logged as keystrokes. We therefore compare each post-AI sentence without AI characters to all sentences of the session’s
chatbot responses and label it ai if the maximum similarity (SequenceMatcher ratio) is ≥ 0.90 \geq 0.90 and mixed if it is ≥ 0.85 \geq 0.85 . This range captures retyped sentences with small edits. Most mixed sentences instead arise from partial pasting.
The remaining sentences are labelled unknown_paste if their unresolved paste share reaches 10%, and potential_influence otherwise. Potential_influence thus marks material written after the student started using the chatbot, but without obvious copy-pasting or retyping of chatbot responses.
blocks.zh:
由于重排的字符被记录为按键中键,因此在字符级别上无法看到手动重制聊天器输出. 因此,我们比较了AI之后的每一个句子,没有AI字符与会话的所有句子.
如果最大相似性(序列马彻比)是 0.90\ geq 0.90,如果是 0.85\ geq 0.85,则混合。 此范围以小编辑方式捕捉重排的句子. 多数混合句子来自部分粘贴。
如果未解决的粘贴份额达到10%,剩下的句子则标注为未知的_paste,否则可能会产生影响。 潜在影响(potential_impact)因此标记了学生开始使用聊天器后所写的材料,但没有明显的复制或重制聊天器回复.

blocks.en: Essays with at least 50% inferred characters are labelled unknown_logger , as a high share across a whole essay indicates unreliable logging of the session. Otherwise, the following rules apply in order: An essay is labelled ai if at least half of its sentences are ai ; otherwise mixed if it contains at least one ai or mixed sentence; otherwise unknown_paste if it contains at least one unknown_paste sentence; otherwise potential_influence if it contains at least one potential_influence sentence. All remaining essays, i.e. those written entirely before chatbot use or in the NoChat condition, are labelled human . task sentences do not affect the text label.
blocks.zh: 包含至少50%推断字符的论文被标注为未知的_logger, 否则,以下规则按顺序适用: 如果至少一半的句子是ai,则作文被贴上ai的标签;如果它至少包含一个ai或混合句子,则有其他混合;如果它至少包含一个未知的_paste句子,则有其他未知的_paste;如果它至少包含一个潜在_影响句子,则有其他潜在_影响. 所有剩余的散文,即那些完全在聊天机使用之前或在NoChat条件下写的散文,都带有人类的标签。 任务句不影响文本标签。

blocks.en: 3.3 Experimental Subset and Data Splits
blocks.zh: 3.3 实验子集和数据分割

blocks.en: We release the full labelled dataset; for our experiments we use the following subset:
blocks.zh: 我们释放完整的标注数据集; 对于我们的实验,我们使用以下子集:

blocks.en: We only use material that is not removed by any of the following exclusion criteria and that carries one of the four labels human , ai , mixed or potential_influence . At text level, we exclude essays with fewer than 10 or more than 10,000 characters, essays consisting only of non-lexical material, essays labelled unknown_logger or unknown_paste , and essays not written predominantly in English, identified semi-automatically with lingua ( Stahl, 2023 ) and word-frequency heuristics based on wordfreq ( Speer et al., 2018 ) . At sentence level, we additionally exclude sentences labelled task or unknown_paste and sentences with at least 50% inferred characters. Table 7 in Appendix A reports the material remaining after each step.
blocks.zh: 我们只使用未经下列任何排除标准排除的材料, 在文字层面,我们排除了小于10个或超过1万个字符的散文,只包含非语言材料的散文,标注为未知的_logger或未知的_paste的散文,以及不以英语为主的散文,用语言识别半自动的(Stahl, 2023)和基于wordfreq的单词频率heuristics(Speer等人, 2018年). 在句子层面,我们还排除了标有任务或未知的_paste的句子,以及至少有50%推断字符的句子. 附录中的表7 一份报告每一步之后剩下的材料。

We split the texts into 80% train, 10% development and 10% test data, assigning all essays of a student to the same partition and balancing labels and writing tasks across partitions.
Sentences inherit their data split assignment from the text they belong to. As texts in the train split were slightly longer, the train split on the sentence level contains more than 80% of all sentences.
blocks.zh:
我们把文本分成80%的列车,10%的开发量和10%的测试数据,将学生的所有论文分配到同一个分区,平衡标签和跨越分区的写作任务.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: We frame AI-authorship detection as supervised classification at text and sentence level, using the same classifiers and splits (Section 3.3 ) throughout. Experiment 1 establishes baselines and examines the ambiguous classes mixed and pi ; Experiments 2–4 examine what the detectors rely on, through feature analysis (Exp. 2) and surface manipulations that could evade detection (Exp. 3 and 4).
blocks.zh: 我们在文字和句子层面将AI-权威检测设定为监督分类,在整个过程中使用相同的分类和划分(第3.3节)。 实验1通过特征分析(第2页)和可能逃避探测的表面操纵(第3和4页),确定基线,并审查混杂和pi的模糊类别;

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We explore two complementary systems that ranked among the top in the 2025 Shared Task: a feature-based classifier over interpretable linguistic features and a classifier over LLM embeddings. Hardware, compute, model versions and licenses, and software versions are given in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 我们探索了在2025年共享任务中排在首位的两个互补系统:一个基于特征的分类器超越可解释的语言特征,另一个是LLM嵌入的分类器. 硬件、计算、模型版本和许可证以及软件版本载于附录E。

blocks.en: Following Indurthi and Varma (2025) , we represent each text with the NELA feature set ( Gruppi et al., 2020 ) , comprising the groups Style (50 features), Complexity (7), Bias (8), Affect (9) and Moral (11), for a total of 85 features. On these we train Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Extra Trees and XGBoost ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) with scikit-learn default hyperparameters ( Pedregosa et al., 2011 ) and a fixed random seed, deliberately reproducing the original setup.
blocks.zh: 继Indurthi和Varma(2025年)之后,我们用NELA特征集(Gruppi等人,2020年)来代表每个文本,由Style(50个特征),Complexity(7),Bias(8),Affect(9)和Moral(11个特征)组成,共85个特征. 在这些上,我们用scikit-learn默认超参数(Pedregosa等人,2011年)和一个固定的随机种子,故意复制原始设置,进行后勤回归、随机森林、外树和XGBoost(陈和Guestrin,2016年)。

blocks.en:
Following Jiao et al. (2025) , we use a frozen Llama-3.1-8B ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) as a proxy model to obtain a single representation per text: input tokens are truncated to a maximum length of 1024, the last-layer hidden states are averaged across all tokens, and the resulting 4096-dimensional vector is classified by a Refined Feature Classification Network (RFCN), a compact convolutional network with three 1D convolutional layers (32, 64, 96 filters; kernel sizes 24, 16, 8) followed by three fully connected layers. The LLM is not fine-tuned; only the RFCN is trained, with AdamW, a linear warmup-decay schedule, batch size 128, learning rate 3e-4, dropout 0.1, and 20 epochs, selecting the checkpoint with the highest macro-F1 on the development set. For hyperparameters not specified in the original paper (pooling size, fully-connected layer widths) see Appendix E . Due to compute constraints we load the model in 8-bit precision rather than fp16. RFCN results are from single training runs; repeated runs differed by up to 0.02 macro-F1, so we do not interpret differences of this size between models.
All non-retrained RFCN evaluations in Experiments 1, 3 and 4 use the same model.
blocks.zh:
跟随焦等人(2025年),我们使用冷冻的Llama-3.1-8B. (Grattafiori等人,2024年)作为每个文本获得单一表示的代理模型: 输入符被切换到最大长度为1024,最后一个层隐藏状态被平均跨越所有符,结果的4096维向量被一个精细的地物分类网络(RFCN)分类,一个紧凑的演化网络,有三个1D的演化层(32,64,96滤层;内核尺寸24,16,8),然后是三个完全连接的层. LLM没有微调;只有RFCN经过训练,亚当W是一个线性热解表,批量尺寸128,学习速率3e-4,辍学率0.1,以及20个纪元,选择在开发集上拥有最高宏F1的检查站. 关于原始纸张中没有说明的超参数(集合大小,全连接层宽度),见附录E。 由于计算限制,我们加载的模型以8位精度而不是fp16. RFCN的成绩来自单项训练;重复训练的成绩差异高达0.02宏-F1,因此我们不解释模型之间的大小差异.
实验1,3和4中所有未经过再培训的RFCN评价都使用同一模型.

blocks.en: Our main metric is macro-F1. We additionally report accuracy in Experiment 1 and the recall of the ai class in Experiment 4, where only ai texts are manipulated.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要衡量标准是宏观F1。 我们还报告实验1的准确性, 以及实验4的AI类被召回, 在那里只有AI文本被操纵。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experiment 1: Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 试验1:基线

blocks.en: Experiment 1 establishes how well the two detectors separate ai from human text. This binary setup is the basis for all following experiments. As a secondary analysis, we examine how the detectors handle the ambiguous classes mixed and potential_influence ( pi ), the grey zone of real-world cases where AI use is partial or unattributable: Are these cases flagged as ai by a detector trained on ai and human only, and can they be separated as classes of their own when the detector is trained on them?
blocks.zh: 实验1确定两个探测器将AI与人类文字分离的好程度. 这种二进制设置是所有后续实验的基础. 作为次要分析,我们研究探测器如何处理混合和潜在影响的模棱两可的类别,即AI使用部分或无法处理的现实世界案例的灰色地带: 这些病例是否仅由接受过ai和人类训练的探测器标注为ai,而当探测器接受过有关这些病例的训练时,这些病例能否作为自己的班级分开?

blocks.en: For the baseline, we train the classifiers on ai and human only. To test recognition, we evaluate the same models on three further test sets in which the grey-zone items are added and relabelled as ai ( mixed , pi , or both). We also apply the binary models to the pi and mixed items alone. Since the models only know ai and human , this forces each item into one of the two, and the resulting split shows whether a model perceives these cases as more ai - or human -like.
blocks.zh: 在基线方面,我们只培训人工和人工分类人员。 为了测试识别,我们在另外三套测试中评估同样的模型,其中灰色区项目被添加并重新标注为ai(混合,pi,或两者兼有). 我们还单独将二进制模型应用于Pi和混合项目. 由于模型只知道AI和人类,这迫使每个项目都变成两个项目中的一个,结果的分裂表明一个模型是认为这些案例更像AI还是人类.

blocks.en: To test learnability, we train classifiers with the grey-zone classes as their own targets, giving a three-way ( ai / human / mixed or ai / human / pi ) or four-way classifier.
blocks.zh: 为了测试学习能力,我们训练以灰色区级为自身目标的分类员,给出一个三进制(ai/人/混合或ai/人/pi)或四进制分类员.

blocks.en:
On the core ai -vs- human task, both the feature-based XGBoost model and the RFCN on frozen Llama-3.1-8B embeddings are effective (Table 2 ). At text level they are near-identical: macro-F1 = 0.95 (XGBoost) and 0.96 (RFCN), accuracy = 0.95 and 0.97. At sentence level they diverge: XGBoost drops to macro-F1 = 0.88, consistent with less evidence per sentence, whereas the RFCN holds at macro-F1 = 0.95.
Both remain below the scores of the original systems on the artificially generated shared-task essays (macro-F1 = 0.986, Indurthi and Varma, 2025 ; macro-F1 = 0.999, Jiao et al., 2025 ), as expected for authentic, student-initiated AI use.
In the following, we report XGBoost, the best feature-based model, and the RFCN.
See Appendix A Table 8 for results on the other models.
blocks.zh:
在核心AI-vs-人类任务上,基于特征的XGBoost模型和冷冻的Llama-3.1-8B嵌入物上的RFCN都是有效的(表2 ). 在文本一级,它们几乎相同:宏-F1=0.95(XGBoost)和0.96(RFCN),准确性=0.95和0.97。 在句子层面,它们存在差异:XGBoost降至宏-F1=0.88,与每句证据较少一致,而RFCN为宏-F1=0.95。
两者都低于人工生成的共享任务散文(macro-F1 = 0.986,Indurthi和Varma,2025;macro-F1 = 0.999,Jiao等人,2025年)上原有系统的分数,如所预期,为真实的,学生发起的AI使用.
下面我们报告XGBoost,最佳的基于特征的模型,以及RFCN.
其他模型的结果见附录A表8。

blocks.en:
Adding the grey-zone items to the test set as ai lowers performance, more so for pi than for mixed (Table 2 ). XGBoost text-level macro-F1 drops from 0.95 to 0.90 with mixed , to 0.81 with pi , and to 0.79 with both. The RFCN behaves similarly (text-level macro-F1 = 0.80 with both); at the sentence level, it remains slightly ahead of XGBoost (macro-F1 = 0.81 vs. 0.76).
Applying the binary models to the grey-zone items (Table 3 ) shows why the detectors rarely flag these items as ai .
blocks.zh:
将灰色区项目作为ai降低性能加入到测试集中,对于pi来说比混合(表2 )要多. XGBooost文本级宏F1从0.95降至0.90(混合),再降至0.81(混合)和pi(混合),再降至0.79。 RFCN的表现类似(文本级宏F1 = 0.80,两者都有);在句子级别,它仍然略高于XGBoost(宏F1 = 0.81对0.76).
将二进制模型应用到灰色区域项目(表3)中可以说明为什么探测器很少将这些项目标为ai 。

blocks.en: Both models classify almost all pi texts as human (94.6% XGBoost, 94.7% RFCN), nearly as often as actual human texts (97.0%, 97.6%). At sentence level, XGBoost classifies more pi as ai (20.6%), the RFCN hardly more (8.8%). mixed splits between the two classes (58.1% ai for XGBoost, 32.3% for the RFCN at text level; only 31 test texts).
blocks.zh: 这两个模型几乎都把所有pi文本归类为人类文本(94.6%的XGBoost,94.7%的RFCN),几乎与实际人类文本相同(97.0%,97.6%). 在句子层面,XGBoost将更多的pi归类为ai(20.6%),RFCN几乎没有更多(8.8%). 两个类别之间的混合分割(XGBoost为58.1% ai,RFCN为32.3%;文本一级只有31个测试文本)。

blocks.en:
Trained as classes of their own (Table 3 ), the grey-zone classes are hardly separable for XGBoost. Its text macro-F1 falls to 0.49–0.69, while accuracy stays at 0.76–0.87, because the majority classes ai and human carry the accuracy and the added class is rarely predicted (text level: recall = 0.19 for mixed , 0.08 for pi ; 89% of pi texts are still classified as human ). Part of this may be due to the small size of the grey-zone classes (306 mixed and 381 pi vs. 1,664 human texts).
The RFCN separates them better, leading XGBoost by 0.12 macro-F1 on ai / human / mixed (0.81 vs. 0.69) and by 0.13 on the four-way task (0.62 vs. 0.49). Experiment 1 shows that both detectors separate ai from human text well, but not what this separation rests on.
blocks.zh:
训练为自己的班级(表3),灰区班级几乎无法为XGBoost分开. 它的文字宏F1下降到0.49–0.69,而精度则保持在0.76–0.87,因为多数类ai和人类携带精度,加成类很少被预测(文字级别:混合的召回=0.19,pi的0.08;89%的pi文本仍被归类为人类). 部分原因可能是灰色区级的面积较小(306种混合型和381种皮对1,664种人类文本).
RFCN将它们区分得更好,领先XGBoost的有0.12 macro-F1在ai / human / 混合(0.81 vs.0.69)上,0.13在四向任务(0.62 vs.0.49)上. 实验1显示,两种探测器都把AI和人类文字分开,但不是这种分离的基础。

blocks.en: 4.3 Experiment 2: Which features carry the signal?
blocks.zh: 4.3 实验 2: 哪些特性带有信号?

blocks.en: Experiment 2 asks which features the feature-based detector relies on, and whether they capture general differences between AI and student writing or only differences specific to one writing task. We restrict this analysis to XGBoost, as the dimensions of the RFCN’s embeddings have no interpretable meaning. We group the NELA features into form (Style, Complexity), which describes how a text is written, and content (Affect, Bias, Moral), which is lexicon-based and tied to what a text says. Content features are the likelier source of task-specific signal: On a given task, the chatbot and the students may write about different aspects of the topic, and hence use different vocabulary, without this difference carrying over to another task.
blocks.zh: 实验2询问基于特征的探测器所依赖的特征,以及它们是否捕捉AI和学生写作之间的一般差异,还是只捕捉一个写作任务特有的差异. 我们仅限于XGBoost分析,因为RFCN嵌入的维度没有可解释的意义. 我们把NELA的特征组合成形式(Style, Complexity),它描述了文字的写法,以及内容(Affect, Bias, Moral),它以词汇为基础,与文字所说的内容联系在一起. 内容特性是任务特定信号的比较来源: 在一个特定的任务上,聊天员和学生可以写出这个话题的不同方面,从而使用不同的词汇,而这种差异不带给另一个任务.

blocks.en: We explain the text-level XGBoost detector from Experiment 1, trained on both tasks, with SHAP values ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) . For every test essay, SHAP assigns each feature a value indicating how strongly and in which direction it pushed the prediction towards ai or human . We report the mean absolute SHAP value per feature as a share of the total importance, both per feature and summed per group.
blocks.zh: 我们解释实验1的文本级XGBoost探测器, 训练有素, 对于每篇测试论文,SHAP都会给每个特征分配一个值,说明它将预测推向AI或人类的程度和方向。 我们报告每个特征的平均绝对SHAP值在总重要性中所占的份额,包括每个特征和每个群体的总和。

blocks.en:
Form features account for 74.4% of the detector’s SHAP importance (Style 41.7%, Complexity 32.7%), content features for 25.6% (Affect 12.1%, Bias 9.9%, Moral 3.6%; Table 4 ). The importance is concentrated on a few features: average word length alone accounts for 19.5%, followed by punctuation (6.1%) and function words (4.7%); the ten most important features together account for 51.6%. The detector predicts ai for texts with longer words, more punctuation, higher readability indices (SMOG, LIX), more plural nouns and more positive words, and human for texts with more function words, adverbs and verbs.
In short, ai text is lexically more complex, while student text is shorter and simpler.
blocks.zh:
形式特征占探测器SHAP重要性的74.4%(Style 41.7%,复杂度32.7%),内容特征占25.6%(Affect 12.1%,比亚斯9.9%,道德3.6%;表4)。 其重要性集中在几个方面:平均单字长度占19.5%,其次是标点(6.1%)和函数词(4.7%);十大特点加起来占51.6%。 探测器预言ai的文本有较长的单词,较多的标点,更高的可读性指数(SMOG,LIX),较多的复数名词和比较正面的单词,而人类的文本有较多的函数词,副词和动词.
简言之,ai文本在逻辑上更为复杂,而学生文本则更为简洁.

blocks.en: To test whether these features generalise across tasks, we train XGBoost on one writing task and evaluate it on the same task ( within ) and on the other task ( cross ). If a feature captures a task-independent difference between ai and human writing, what is learned on one task should carry over to the other; if the difference arises from the task, for example because chatbot and students address different aspects of it, performance drops. Both tasks contain a similar share of ai texts (35% and 38% in the training set), and training sets are downsampled to equal size (1,030 texts) with label proportions preserved. We train on each NELA group, on form and content combined, and on the full NELA set, and report macro-F1 within and cross, each averaged over both tasks, as well as the drop from within to cross for each transfer direction.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这些特征是否贯穿所有任务,我们对XGBoost进行一项写作任务的培训,并对同一任务(内部)和另一项任务(交叉)进行评估。 如果一个特性能捕捉到ai和人文写作之间一个任务独立的区别,那么在一个任务上学到的东西应该延续到另一个任务上;如果这个区别产生于任务,例如由于聊天机器人和学生处理它的不同方面,表现会下降. 这两项任务都包含类似比例的AI文本(在培训集中为35%和38%),培训集被取样到同等大小(1 030个文本),并保留标签比例。 我们在每个NELA组、形式和内容组合、整个NELA组以及内部和交叉报告宏观-F1,每个组平均完成两个任务,每个转移方向从内部向交叉下降。

blocks.en: Within a task, all feature sets perform similarly (macro-F1 = 0.91–0.95), but they transfer differently (Table 4 ). Content features drop the most (by 0.17 macro-F1 on average and by 0.29 when trained on teacher ), so they partly learn the task rather than the authorship. Form features transfer better (Complexity: 0.03, Style: 0.08, Style and Complexity combined: 0.10), with losses mainly when training on advertisement and testing on teacher , while content fails mainly in the opposite direction. Only the full NELA set is stable in both directions (drop ≤ \leq 0.02), as the groups compensate for each other’s losses. With about 130 test texts per task, single per-direction differences should be read with caution. Overall, the difference between ai and human writing lies more in form than in content and largely holds across the two tasks.
blocks.zh: 在一项任务中,所有功能集的性能类似(macro-F1 = 0.91–0.95),但它们的传输方式不同(表4). 内容特征下降最多(平均为0.17 宏-F1,在师资培训时为0.29),因此他们部分学习任务而不是作者身份. 形式特性转移更好(Complexity:0.03,Style:0.08,Style and Complexity合并:0.10),损失主要发生在教师的广告和测试培训上,而内容主要在相反方向失败. 只有完整的NELA集在双向稳定(prot \\leq 0.02),因为各组相互补偿对方的损失. 每个任务约130个测试文本,每个方向的单一差异应谨慎阅读. 总体而言,ai与人文写作的区别在形式上比在内容上要大,基本上贯穿于两项任务之中.

blocks.en: 4.4 Experiment 3: Spelling Manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.4 实验3:拼写操纵

blocks.en: Experiment 3 tests whether the detectors use spelling errors, the most visible surface difference between student and chatbot text, as a shortcut. No NELA feature measures spelling directly, so misspellings can affect XGBoost only indirectly (e.g. through word length or part-of-speech tags), whereas the RFCN processes the raw tokens.
blocks.zh: 实验3测试探测器是否使用拼写错误作为捷径,这是学生和聊天员文本最明显的表面差异. 没有NELA的特征度量直接拼写,因此错拼只能间接地影响XGBoost(例如通过词长或片段标记),而RFCN处理原始符.

blocks.en: We identify misspellings automatically following Horbach et al. (2017) , accepting words found in a dictionary, frequent in English, or manually verified as topic words or names, and correct them with SymSpell (details in Appendix C ). Student texts contain far more misspellings than chatbot output (4.36 vs. 0.72 per 100 words in the text-level test set). In correct , we correct all misspellings in human texts (4.36 → \to 0.01). In mistake , we insert misspellings attested in human texts into ai texts, sampled by frequency, until the error rate matches human writing (0.72 → \to 5.06). We evaluate the baseline detectors on each manipulated test set and additionally retrain them on each manipulated variant.
blocks.zh: 我们自动识别跟随Horbach等人(2017年)的错拼,接受在词典中发现的,经常使用英语的单词,或手动核实为主题单词或名称,并用SymSpell(附录C中的细节)进行校正. 学生的文本中包含的错拼远远多于Chatbot输出(在文本级别测试集中每100字有4.36对0.72). 正确,我们纠正了人类文本中的所有误写(4.36 ~\==0.01)。 错误地,我们将人类文本中证实的误填输入Ai文本,按频率取样,直到误写率与人类书写相匹配(0.72~\==5.06)。 我们评估每个被操纵的测试机组的基线探测器,并另外对每个被操纵的变体进行再培训。

blocks.en: As expected, neither manipulation affects XGBoost: macro-F1 stays within 0.01 of the baseline throughout (Table 5 ). The RFCN loses 0.02 macro-F1 at text level and up to 0.03 at sentence level ( mistake : 0.95 → \to 0.92). These drops are small but significant in a paired bootstrap over students (Appendix C ). They are also one-directional: inserted misspellings turn ai predictions into human (86 sentences, 0 reverse), and corrections turn human into ai (19 sentences, 1 reverse). Retrained on manipulated data, the RFCN performs as well as before. Spelling, a cue teachers rely on, is thus no shortcut for XGBoost and only a weak cue for the RFCN.
blocks.zh: 如预期的那样,操纵既不影响XGBoost:宏观-F1在整个过程中保持在基线0.01范围内(表5)。 RFCN在文字层面损失0.02宏-F1,在句子层面损失高达0.03(错误:0.95 →\to 0.92). 这些滴水量很小,但在学生身上的双靴子(附录C)中却很大。 它们也是单向的:插入的错拼将ai的预测变成人(86句,0反向),修正将人变为ai(19句,1反向). 重新对被操纵的数据进行训练,RFCN也执行之前。 拼写是老师们所依赖的,

blocks.zh: 表5:拼音操纵下的宏F1. 列车/测试数据:原始(orig)或被操纵(正确,错误).

blocks.en: 4.5 Experiment 4: Rewriting AI text to sound like a student
blocks.zh: 4.5 实验4:将AI文本重写成学生般的声音

blocks.en: Experiment 4 asks whether students could have hidden their AI use by asking the chatbot to make its text sound like their own writing. Whereas Experiment 3 manipulated spelling, we target the form features identified in Experiment 2. We rewrite all ai texts of the text-level test sets with gpt-4o-mini , the model available to the students, using two prompts. The student prompt is a simple request of the kind a student might write. The informed prompt additionally lists the properties that distinguish human from ai text in Experiment 2. As it uses knowledge learned by the detector, it serves as a best case for evasion rather than a realistic scenario. To test whether the results depend on the rewriting model, we repeat the rewriting with Qwen3-14B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) (4-bit, via Ollama 2 2 2 https://ollama.com ), which belongs to a different model family than both gpt-4o-mini and the Llama embeddings of the RFCN. All generations use temperature 0; human texts are not changed. Both prompts are given in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 实验4询问学生是否可以通过要求聊天器使其文字听起来像他们自己的写作来隐藏他们的AI使用. 而实验3被操纵的拼写,我们针对实验2中所确定的形式特征. 我们用 gpt-4o-mini 重写文本级测试集的所有 AI 文本, 可供学生使用的模型, 使用两个提示 。 学生提示是学生可能写的那种简单的请求. 知情的迅速性还列出了实验2中区分人类和AI文本的属性. 由于它利用探测器学到的知识,它成为逃避的最佳案例,而不是现实情景。 为了测试结果是否取决于重写模式,我们用Qune3-14B重复重写. (Yang et al., 2025) (4-bit,通过Ollama 2 2 2 https://ollama.com),它与gpt-4o-mini和Llama嵌入RFCN属于不同的模型家族. 所有世代使用温度0;人文文本不变. 附录B提供了两个提示。

blocks.en: Both gpt-4o-mini prompts moved the form features towards human writing: median average word length fell from 5.69 to 4.45 ( student ) and 4.39 ( informed ; human: 4.35), and both rewrites use more pronouns and function words. Only the informed prompt shortened the texts (median word count: 325 → \to 183; human: 163), and neither reduced punctuation nor positive sentiment. The rewrites remain semantically close to the originals (mean cosine similarity based on all-MiniLM-L6-v2 text embeddings ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ) = 0.84 for student , 0.79 for informed ).
blocks.zh: gpt-4o-mini laims将形态特征向人类书写方向移动:中位平均字长从5.69降至4.45(学生)和4.39(知情;人:4.35),两者重写都使用更多的代词和函数词. 只有知情的即时报缩短了文本(中间单词计数:325~\=183;人文:163),并且既不减少发音,也不减少正面情绪. 重写仍然与原作相近(基于全MiniLM-L6-v2文本嵌入的普通同位素相似性(Reimers and Gurevich, 2019)=0.84,学生为0.79,知情者为0.79).

blocks.en:
We evaluate the Experiment 1 models on the rewritten test sets without retraining and report macro-F1 and ai recall, i.e. the share of rewritten ai items still detected.
At sentence level, rewritten texts are re-segmented with pySBD; since they cannot be paired with the original sentences, all are labelled ai (including any the student had written), and we report ai recall on them.
blocks.zh:
我们在不进行再培训的情况下对重写测试集上的实验1模型进行评估,并报告宏-F1和AI召回,即重写AI项目的份额仍然被检测到.
在句子层面,重写文本与 pySBD 重排;由于无法与原句对齐,所以全部被标注为ai(包括学生写过的任何内容),我们报告ai召回.

blocks.en: Rewriting substantially lowers XGBoost detection (Table 6 ): with gpt-4o-mini , its ai recall falls from 0.92 to 0.60 ( student ) and 0.39 ( informed ). Even the student prompt, written without knowledge of the detector, hides about a third of detected ai texts. Qwen3-14B rewrites lower recall as much or more. The detector rests largely on form differences that a single prompt can remove.
blocks.zh: 重写大大降低了XGBooost检测(表6):gpt-4o-mini的ai召回率从0.92降至0.60(学生)和0.39(知情)。 连学生在不懂得探测器的情况下写作的提示,都隐藏了约三分之一的检测到的AI文本. Quen3-14B 重写低调的召回量和多或多. 探测器主要依靠单一的提示可以消除的形式差异。

blocks.en:
The RFCN, in contrast, is unaffected at text level: its ai recall stays at 0.94 or above for both prompts and both rewriting models (original: 0.95).
This is unlikely to be merely recognition of gpt-4o-mini ’s style, which produced all ai training data: texts rewritten by Qwen3, from a different model family, are detected just as reliably. The RFCN thus captures properties of LLM-generated text that survive style-level rewriting; we leave it to future work to determine which properties these are.
blocks.zh:
相比之下,RFCN在文字层面没有受到影响:其ai record既保留在0.94或以上,既用于提示,又用于重写模型(原文:0.95)。
这不可能仅仅是承认gpt-4o-mini的风格,它产生了所有AI训练数据:由Qune3重写的来自不同模范家庭的文本同样可靠。 因此RFCN捕捉了LLM生成的文本在风格级重写中存活下来的属性;我们把它留给未来的工作来确定这些属性是什么.

blocks.en:
At sentence level, rewriting affects both detectors more strongly. The ai recall of XGBoost falls from 0.86 to 0.25–0.49 across rewrites. Unlike at text level, the RFCN is also clearly affected, though less than XGBoost: its ai recall falls from 0.94 to 0.59–0.90.
Here, the rewriting model matters about as much as the prompt: Qwen3 lowers ai recall more than gpt-4o-mini for both prompts ( student : 0.74 vs. 0.90; informed : 0.59 vs. 0.70).
As ai recall on rewritten sentences varied by up to 0.05 between training runs, only larger differences should be interpreted. The stronger effect of Qwen3 may indicate that part of this signal is specific to gpt-4o-mini , or that Qwen3 rewrites more strongly.
blocks.zh:
在句子层面,重写会更强烈地影响两个探测器. XGBoost的ai record从0.86跌至0.25–0.49,经过改写. 与文本层面不同的是,RFCN也明显受到影响,虽然低于XGBoost:它的ai召回从0.94下降到0.59–0.90.
在这里,重写模型与即时: Qwen3更低的ai对两个提示(学生:0.74对0.90;通知:0.59对0.70)的回音都超过了gpt-4o-mini.
由于在改写的句子上,培训活动之间的差别高达0.05,因此只应解释较大的差别。 Quen3的较强效果可能表明这个信号的一部分是gpt-4o-mini的特异性,或者Quen3的重写更强烈.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We evaluated two state-of-the-art AI-text detectors on authentic student writing, with labels derived from keystroke, clipboard and chat logs.
Regarding RQ1, AI text from loosely prompted, student-initiated chatbot use is not substantially harder to detect than researcher-generated text. Both detectors separate ai from human reliably at text level.
At sentence level, which is needed to locate AI material in partially AI-written essays, only the embedding-based detector keeps this performance; the feature-based detector drops noticeably. Partial AI use, however, does not fit the binary framing. mixed text falls between the two classes, and the detectors disagree on where it belongs. pi text is read as human-written and stays hard to separate even when trained as a class of its own. Regarding RQ2, what the detectors rely on matters more than how well they score. The feature-based detector has mainly learned that AI text is lexically more complex. This difference holds across tasks, but a single rewriting prompt removes it. The embedding-based detector still recognises authorship of rewritten whole texts, regardless of the rewriting model, but loses a substantial share of rewritten single sentences, especially when another model does the rewriting. Spelling errors, a cue teachers report relying on, play almost no role for either detector.
Text-based detection can thus reliably tell whether a whole essay was produced with a chatbot, but locating AI material at sentence level is fragile, as a single rewriting prompt is enough to hide much of it. AI support that leaves no copied or retyped text in the essay, such as using the chatbot for ideas or language help, cannot be identified from the text at all. Future work should identify which properties the embedding-based detector relies on, improve its robustness at sentence level, and examine what kinds of AI use underlie pi text.
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup
关于RQ1, 由松散诱导的AI文本, 学生发起的聊天器使用比研究人员生成的文本要难得多。 两种探测器在文本层面将AI与人类可靠分离.
在句子层面,需要将AI材料定位在部分AI写作的散文中,只有嵌入式探测器保持这种性能;基于特征的探测器明显下降. 然而,部分AI的使用并不符合二进制框架. 混合文本落在两个类别之间,探测器对其所属位置有分歧. pi文字被读作人文文字,即使作为自己的一个班级受训,也很难分开. 关于RQ2,探测器所依赖的比得分多得多。 基于特征的探测器主要得知AI文本在逻辑上更为复杂. 这种差异存在于不同的任务中,但是一个单重写即刻删除. 基于嵌入的探测器仍然承认重写整个文本的作者身份,无论重写模式如何,但失去了大量重写单句,特别是当另一个模型进行重写时. 拼写错误,一个提示教师报告依赖,几乎对两个探测器都没有作用.
因此,基于文字的检测可以可靠地分辨出整篇散文是否用一个聊天器制作,但将AI材料定位在句子级别上是脆弱的,因为一个单一的重写提示足以隐藏大部分内容. AI支持在散文中不留下复制或重排的文本,例如使用聊天机进行思想或语言帮助,完全无法从文本中识别出来. 今后的工作应当确定嵌入式探测器所依赖的属性,提高它在句子层面的稳健性,并审查Pi文本背后使用何种AI。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our gold labels rely on manually set thresholds (e.g. the 90% AI share and the 0.85/0.90 similarity thresholds for retyped text), and provenance cannot capture AI material that students paraphrased heavily or used only for ideas. All ai text was produced by gpt-4o-mini , and all writers are 15-year-old EFL students from Germany on two argumentative tasks, so results may not transfer to other generators, populations or genres. The text-level test set is small (96 ai , 169 human texts). Finally, our manipulations are simulated; real students may evade detection in other ways, such as editing the output by hand.
blocks.zh: 我们的金色标签依赖于手动设定的阈值(如重排文本的90%AI份额和0.85/0.90相似阈值),出处无法捕捉学生大量诠释或只用于思想的AI材料. 所有ai文本都是由gpt-4o-mini(英语:gpt-4o-mini)制作的,所有作家都是来自德国的15岁的EFL学生,从事两个论证性任务,因此结果可能不会转移到其他发电机,种群或流派. 文本级别测试集规模较小(96 ai,169 个人文本). 最后,我们的操纵是模拟的;真正的学生可能以其他方式逃避检测,比如用手编辑输出.

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
AI-authorship detectors should not be used as standalone evidence of academic misconduct or for consequential decisions about individual students. False positives may lead to unjustified accusations, and our results show substantial uncertainty for mixed, rewritten, and post-AI writing.
The PISA-FLA data were accessed under the data-protection and research-use procedures of the original study; analyses use pseudonymized data and do not attempt to identify individual students.
Data collection followed the standard PISA consent procedures and was approved by an ethics committee and by the ministries of education of all
participating federal states.
Artificial Intelligence has been used for creating this work in tasks as supporting code writing, translation and editing of text. All generated code was tested before usage.
blocks.zh:
AI-权威探测器不应被用作学术不当行为的独立证据或针对个别学生作出相应决定。 假阳性可能导致不合理的指责,我们的结果表明,对混合、改写和后AI写作有很大的不确定性。
PISA-FLA数据是根据原始研究的数据保护和研究使用程序获取的;分析使用假名数据,不试图识别个别学生.
数据收集遵循PISA标准同意程序,并得到道德操守委员会和教育部的批准
参加联邦州。
人工智能在支持代码编写、翻译和编辑文本的任务中被用于创建这项工作。 所有生成的代码在使用前都经过测试.

blocks.en: Appendix C Spelling Manipulation (Experiment 3)

blocks.en:
A word counts as correctly spelled if it is listed in the Hunspell en_US dictionary 3 3 3 https://hunspell.github.io or is frequent in English according to wordfreq ( Speer et al., 2018 ) (Zipf frequency ≥ 3.5 \geq 3.5 , i.e. about three occurrences per million words); the latter accepts common British spellings, which en_US rejects.
Topic words and names are often missing from both resources and would be flagged as errors. We therefore also accept words from our corpus, under conditions that keep out recurring learner misspellings: a word must occur in at least five texts and under at least two labels, so that a single student repeating a misspelling does not count as evidence; it must not be German; and it must not be one edit away from a frequent English word (Zipf ≥ 4 \geq 4 ), unless it is mostly capitalised, i.e. a name. This yields 290 candidate types, of which we manually accepted 32 as correct spellings (mainly topic words and names).
Frequent German words and contractions without an apostrophe ( dont ) are not counted as errors. Frequent misspellings were corrected by hand at type level, all others with the nearest dictionary word suggested by SymSpell 4 4 4 https://github.com/wolfgarbe/SymSpell (Damerau–Levenshtein distance ≤ 3 \leq 3 ). In the text-level test set, correct alters 151 of 169 human texts and mistake alters 95 of 96 ai texts; the mistake error rate overshoots human writing because of errors already present in the ai texts.
blocks.zh:

两种资源都常常缺少专题词和名称,因此会被标为错误。 因此,我们也接受我们教程中的词语,条件是避免反复出现的学习者误写:一个词必须出现在至少五个文本和至少两个标签下,这样一个学生重复误写不能算作证据;它不能是德语;它不能是一个经常从英语词(Zipf ≥ 4\ geq 4)中编辑出来的词,除非它大多是大写,即一个名字. 这产生了290种候选类型,其中我们手动接受32种为正确的拼写(主要是主题词和名称).

blocks.en:
We use the base model Llama-3.1-8B (Llama 3.1 Community License), loaded in 8-bit precision with bitsandbytes due to GPU memory constraints. As no code was released, we reimplemented the RFCN following Jiao et al. (2025) ; for unspecified hyperparameters we use max-pooling (size 2) after each convolutional layer and fully connected layers of width 128 and 64 before the output layer, with ReLU activations and dropout before and after the first fully connected layer. We use a 10% linear warmup, AdamW with default weight decay (0.01), unweighted cross-entropy, and seed 42. Embeddings are mean-pooled over non-padding tokens and stored in float16.
For Experiment 4 we use gpt-4o-mini ( gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 , OpenAI Terms of Use) and Qwen3-14B (14.8B parameters,
Q4_K_M quantization, Ollama 0.40.2, thinking disabled, Apache 2.0). No hyperparameter search was performed.

我们使用Llama-3.1-8B(Llama 3.1 Community License)基型,由于GPU内存限制,以8位精度加载. 由于没有发布代码,我们在Jiao等人(2025年)之后重新实施了RFCN;对于未说明的超参数,我们使用每个演化层后的最大集合(大小为2)和输出层前完全连接的宽度128和64的层,在第一个完全连接层之前和之后的RELU激活和退出. 我们使用10%的线性热身,亚当W带有默认的重量衰变(0.01),未加权的交叉性,以及42种种子. 嵌入物在非打字符上进行平均拼合,并存储在浮点16中.
对于实验4,我们使用gpt-4o-mini(gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18,OpenAI的使用条款)和Qune3-14B(14.8B参数),
Q4_K_M 量化,Ollama 0.40.2,思维残疾,Apache 2.0. 未进行超参数搜索。
